crossRefs.note: He lurks in secret as a lion in his ambush. He lies in wait to catch the helpless. He catches the helpless when he…
The helpless are crushed. They collapse. They fall under his strength.
The wicked watch the righteous, and seek to kill him.
Yahweh will not leave him in his hand, nor condemn him when he is judged.
They also who seek after my life lay snares. Those who seek my hurt speak mischievous things, and meditate deceits all…
They conspire and lurk, watching my steps. They are eager to take my life.
Saul spoke to Jonathan his son, and to all his servants, that they should kill David. But Jonathan, Saul’s son, greatly…
The words of the wicked are about lying in wait for blood, but the speech of the upright rescues them.
The godly man has perished out of the earth, and there is no one upright among men. They all lie in wait for blood…
Therefore don’t yield to them, for more than forty men lie in wait for him, who have bound themselves under a curse to…
The kings of the earth take a stand, and the rulers take counsel together, against Yahweh, and against his Anointed…
The kings of the earth take a stand, and the rulers take council together, against the Lord, and against his Christ.’
“For truly, both Herod and Pontius Pilate, with the Gentiles and the people of Israel, were gathered together against…
Yahweh, my God, if I have done this, if there is iniquity in my hands,
Those who hate me without a cause are more than the hairs of my head. Those who want to cut me off, being my enemies…
Moreover, my father, behold, yes, see the skirt of your robe in my hand; for in that I cut off the skirt of your robe…
He said to David, “You are more righteous than I; for you have done good to me, whereas I have done evil to you.
He said, “Why does my lord pursue his servant? For what have I done? What evil is in my hand?
But this happened so that the word may be fulfilled which was written in their law, ‘They hated me without a cause.’

translations.web: For, behold, they lie in wait for my soul. The mighty gather themselves together against me, not for my disobedience, nor for my sin, Yahweh.
translations.bsb: See how they lie in wait for me. Fierce men conspire against me for no transgression or sin of my own, O LORD.
translations.kjv: For, lo, they lie in wait for my soul: the mighty are gathered against me; not for my transgression, nor for my sin, O LORD.
translations.asv: For, lo, they lie in wait for my soul; The mighty gather themselves together against me: Not for my transgression, nor for my sin, O Jehovah.
